mapper.select: SELECT * FROM crm_service_ticket WHERE ticket_id = #{id} AND deleted = 0 FOR UPDATE

SELECT t.ticket_id, t.tenant_id, t.customer_id, t.customer_name, t.ticket_no, t.ticket_title, t.severity, t.issue_type, t.owner_id, t.owner_name, t.opened_time, t.resolved_time, t.due_time, t.description, t.solution, t.portal_contact_id, t.portal_solution, t.portal_solution_time, t.attachment_url, t.status, t.sla_policy_id, t.first_response_due, t.resolution_due, t.first_response_time, t.first_response_minutes, t.resolution_minutes, t.sla_paused_minutes, t.pause_start_time, t.sla_status, t.response_breached_flag, t.resolution_breached_flag, t.version, t.deleted, t.create_by, t.create_time, t.update_by, t.update_time, CASE WHEN t.portal_contact_id IS NOT NULL AND t.owner_id = #{currentUserId} THEN #{currentDeptId} ELSE c.dept_id END AS scope_dept_id, CASE WHEN t.portal_contact_id IS NOT NULL AND t.owner_id = #{currentUserId} THEN t.owner_id ELSE c.owner_id END AS scope_owner_id FROM crm_service_ticket t INNER JOIN crm_customer c ON c.customer_id = t.customer_id AND c.deleted = '0' WHERE t.ticket_id = #{ticketId} AND t.deleted = '0'
